Theme for patchwork annotations

Source: R/theme-patchwork.R
theme_patchwork.Rd

Returns the plot-level parts of theme_ekio() for use with patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = ). The theme colors the outer canvas and styles titles without changing the panels or axes of child plots.

Usage

theme_patchwork(background = "offwhite", ...)

Arguments

background

Character. Background surface accepted by theme_ekio().

...

Additional arguments passed to theme_ekio().

Value

A partial ggplot2 theme.

See also

theme_ekio()

Examples

theme_patchwork(background = "offwhite")
#> <theme> List of 5
#>  $ plot.background: <ggplot2::element_rect>
